title: Content Marketing Specialist (12-month contract)
jobDescription:
responsibilities) Plan content across touchpoints
- from a social ad to a You Tube tutorial to a product surface
- so every piece of content is shaped for the context in which it lands. Script & produce a bank of short-form video content for multiple touchpoints
- so the Marketing team always has fresh, tested content to work with. Brief and coordinate with external agencies or internal creative teams to make production-heavy content, specially video content. Experiment with new content formats for Canva's product surfaces
- including the homepage, landing pages and other surfaces, such as highlights, videos, learning cards, etc. Manage end-to-end content execution

- you can speak credibly about what Canva can do, and that knowledge shows up naturally in the content you create. You think in channels and touchpoints

experienceProfile.rawText: responsibilities) Plan content across touchpoints - from a social ad to a You Tube tutorial to a product surface - so every piece of content is shaped for the context in which it lands. Script & produce a bank of short-form video content for multiple touchpoints - so the Marketing team always has fresh, tested content to work with. Brief and coordinate with external agencies or internal creative teams to make production-heavy content, specially video content. Experiment with new content formats for Canva's product surfaces - including the homepage, landing pages and other surfaces, such as highlights, videos, learning cards, etc. Manage end-to-end content execution - content scheduling, CMS uploads, A/B tests across platforms and surfaces. Coordinate localisation across languages where needed - a working understanding of Hindi is required, as most India localisation will be in this language. Measure the impact of the content, and calibrate future plans according to new insights and learnings. What we're looking for You write clearly and versatilely across formats - from punchy Shorts scripts to instructional video copy to product interface language. You're an avid Canva user who knows the product's workflows and use cases inside out - you can speak credibly about what Canva can do, and that knowledge shows up naturally in the content you create. You think in channels and touchpoints - you instinctively ask "where will someone see this, and what do they need from it at that moment?" before you write or brief a single word. You are comfortable facing the camera, and have a good screen presence to represent a brand like Canva in India. You have a sharp eye for social and design trends - you're the kind of person who spots an emerging content format or visual style early, and can translate that into new ideas. You take genuine ownership of your output - you flag blockers early, manage your own time across multiple content surfaces, and care about whether your work actually lands with users. You're comfortable working to a brief and taking feedback in your stride - you see revision as part of the craft, not a setback. You have a good understanding of Hindi and are comfortable reviewing or briefing localised content to ensure it reads naturally for Indian users - not just translated, but truly local. You're based in Bangalore and ready to contribute across a range of content types from day one. What you will learn and how you will develop at Canva Multi-surface content marketing - you'll develop real experience writing & producing social content, product content, and You Tube in a single role, giving you a rounded view of how content works across the funnel. Stakeholder and project management - you'll learn how to brief external agencies, manage feedback loops, and keep multiple content workstreams moving at once, building production and stakeholder coordination skills that are invaluable in any marketing role. You Tube & social content strategy - you'll learn how to build a content funnel designed around search behaviour, create for discoverability, and grow an audience in one of the world's most competitive You Tube markets. A strong, full-funnel content portfolio - over 12 months, you'll have published work across social media, product interfaces, homepage, and other touchpoints. About the Group/Team CJKI is the group responsible for making Canva feel like a local product in four of its most dynamic markets - China, Japan, Korea, and India. We sit within Canva's International Supergroup, whose mission is to empower those closest to our international customers to drive Truly Local growth across our top 40 markets. Our group operates with genuine autonomy, building in-market functions across marketing, product, engineering, data, and user voice - with the support of Canva's central teams behind us. India is one of our most active and ambitious subgroups, with growing teams in SEO, marketing, and product all working toward the same goal: making Canva indispensable for Indian creators, educators, and businesses, and growing our active user base in the country. title: Project Manager, Education Team (Full time, 1-year contract)
jobDescription:
Project Manager, Education Team (Full time, 1-year contract), Vijayawada, ANDHRA PRADESH, India | Canva Careers Skip to main content 中文 0 Your jobs Jobs Our culture Close dropdown Our culture Benefits & ways of working Belonging at Canva Two-Step Plan Teams Close dropdown Teams Engineering Product Management Design Sales and Success Marketing Operations Finance Customer Happiness Legal People Information Technology Locations Close dropdown Locations Australia United States United Kingdom Philippines New Zealand Austria Czechia China Careers and growth Close dropdown Careers and growth How we hire Career tools Early careers Blog 中文 Project Manager, Education Team (Full time, 1-year contract) Team Operations Country Vijayawada / India Schedule Full-time Location Type Onsite Description What you’d be doing in this role We are seeking a passionate and proactive Project Manager to support the implementation and scaling of Canva Education across Government and private school systems in Andhra Pradesh. The team member will be based at the Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) office in Vijayawada, contributing to the Project Management Unit (PMU).This role will act as a local anchor for our state-level initiatives, helping drive teacher adoption, support partnership initiatives, and ensure alignment with educational priorities including the National Education Policy
2020. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of education, technology, and system change — bringing creativity, collaboration, and equity into classrooms at scale. At the moment, this role is focused on: Coordinate and support the execution of Canva Education programs in partnership with the State Government, SCERTs, teacher training institutions, and local NGOs. Serve as a key point of contact for field-level stakeholders including school administrators, DIETs, CRCs/BRCs, and master trainers. Support planning and delivery of training programs for teachers, administrators, and implementation partners. Collaborate with internal Canva teams (Partnerships, Product, Community, Data) to ensure smooth implementation and troubleshooting of product rollouts. Track and report on adoption metrics, success stories, and program impact at the ground level. Coordinate localization of content, resources, and communication to ensure cultural and linguistic relevance. Identify risks and implementation challenges early and flag them with mitigation plans. Support day-to-day coordination with state education departments and facilitate reviews, updates, and planning meetings. You're probably a match if you Have at least 3 years of experience in the K-12 education field, especially with government schools or large-scale programs. Experience in coordinating or running edtech programs through NGOs, CSR, Ed Tech organizations, or government partnerships. A strong grasp of the National Education Policy (NEP 2020), particularly in digital education, foundational learning, and teacher capacity building. Excellent communication skills in English and Telugu — both spoken and written. Proven ability to work in dynamic, cross-functional, and remote teams. Comfortable juggling multiple stakeholders and timelines. Organized, detail-oriented, and proactive with a knack for solving problems. Adaptable and creative, comfortable with uncertainty, and eager to learn, grow, and innovate. Quickly build trust by showing integrity, credibility, and consistency in every interaction. Show grit and resilience — you're resourceful, proactive, and action-focused. Stay humble, open to feedback, and always looking for ways to improve. Other stuff to know We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don’t feel like your skills quite match what’s listed above
- we still want to hear from you! Please note that interviews are conducted virtually. Join the team redefining how the world experiences design. Hey, g'day, namaste, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte! Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point. Where and how you can work The Project Manager is expected to operate from the education department office of the State and provide support for Canva Education initiatives. About the team The Canva Education team in India is a mission-driven group working to embed creativity, collaboration, and visual communication across classrooms nationwide. We actively partner with state governments, national-level education bodies, and large private school networks to scale Canva Education as a safe, inclusive, and impactful teaching and learning platform. Our team brings deep expertise across education policy, teacher training, and edtech implementation—aligning Canva’s global mission with India’s priorities such as NEP 2020, foundational learning, multilingual classrooms, and digital equity. Whether it’s a district in rural Tamil Nadu or a private school in Delhi, we’re working to ensure that every educator and student can design and learn with confidence. title: Product Localisation Lead - India
jobDescription:
Product Localisation Lead
- India, Bengaluru, , India | Canva Careers Skip to main content 中文 0 Your jobs Jobs Our culture Close dropdown Our culture Benefits & ways of working Belonging at Canva Two-Step Plan Teams Close dropdown Teams Engineering Product Management Design Sales and Success Marketing Operations Finance Customer Happiness Legal People Information Technology Locations Close dropdown Locations Australia United States United Kingdom Philippines New Zealand Austria Czechia China Careers and growth Close dropdown Careers and growth How we hire Career tools Early careers Blog 中文 Product Localisation Lead
- India Team Growth Country Bengaluru / India Schedule Full-time Location Type Remote Description Join the team redefining how the world experiences design. Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, namaste! Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point. Where and how you can work Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role, we’re focusing on Bangalore so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing. What you’d be doing in this role Own Canva’s product and localisation strategy for India, with a strong focus on user growth and experience across languages. Contribute to the product roadmap for India, including features, payment methods, authentication flows, and other market-specific initiatives. Analyse the active user and subscription funnels to identify opportunities for improving activation, engagement, and conversion. Evaluate and adapt global messaging, campaigns, and product experiences to resonate with Indian users across different regions and languages. Provide cultural and linguistic insights to global teams to inform product, content, and marketing decisions. Project management to drive cross-functional collaboration on localisation: Marketing, Content, SEO and Product Manage relationships with external localisation partners and collaborate with external linguists, translators and the in-house Language Manager, to ensure clarity, cultural nuance, and consistency across all Indian-language experiences. Together, develop and evolve style guides, tone of voice principles, and best practices for the region. Help prioritise localisation investments across languages and regions based on impact, scale, and user needs. What we're looking for 5+ years of experience working in product, growth, or localisation roles within a high-growth Saa S or product-led company. Strong product and growth mindset, with an understanding of how India’s language ecosystem (including regional languages and English usage patterns) influences user behaviour and product adoption. Strong understanding of content and UX copy, including the ability to write and adapt English-language messaging for Indian users across product and growth surfaces. Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, content, and regional teams. Fluency in English, with strong proficiency in at least one major Indian language. Familiarity with multiple Indian languages is a strong plus. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and scaling solutions in complex, multi-market environments. A strategic thinker who is equally happy rolling up their sleeves and executing. Genuine passion for Canva’s mission to empower the world to design. About the Group/Team Canva’s International Supergroup is responsible for driving growth and deepening adoption across our key regions worldwide. We are an entrepreneurial, cross-functional team that turns bold strategy into culturally resonant execution. In India, our mission is to empower people across the country to design and express themselves, regardless of language, geography, or background. India represents one of Canva’s most important growth opportunities, with a deeply diverse language ecosystem, a rapidly expanding creator economy, and millions of users coming online for the first time. Our goal is to make Canva feel intuitive, accessible, and truly local for users across India. About the Role/Specialty As the India Localisation Lead, you will own Canva’s product and localisation experience in India, ensuring users across different regions and languages have the best possible Canva experience. You will be the voice of Indian users and a champion for culturally and linguistically relevant product experiences. This role goes beyond translation. It requires a strong understanding of India’s language landscape, how users switch between languages, and how localisation decisions impact trust, usability, and growth at scale. - India Team Growth Country Bengaluru / India Schedule Full-time Location Type Remote Description Join the team redefining how the world experiences design. Hey, hello, hiya, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte, namaste! Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point. Where and how you can work Our headquarters is in sunny Sydney, Australia, but our team spans the globe. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role, we’re focusing on Bangalore so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing. What you’d be doing in this role Own Canva’s product and localisation strategy for India, with a strong focus on user growth and experience across languages. Contribute to the product roadmap for India, including features, payment methods, authentication flows, and other market-specific initiatives. Analyse the active user and subscription funnels to identify opportunities for improving activation, engagement, and conversion. Evaluate and adapt global messaging, campaigns, and product experiences to resonate with Indian users across different regions and languages. Provide cultural and linguistic insights to global teams to inform product, content, and marketing decisions. Project management to drive cross-functional collaboration on localisation: Marketing, Content, SEO and Product Manage relationships with external localisation partners and collaborate with external linguists, translators and the in-house Language Manager, to ensure clarity, cultural nuance, and consistency across all Indian-language experiences. Together, develop and evolve style guides, tone of voice principles, and best practices for the region. Help prioritise localisation investments across languages and regions based on impact, scale, and user needs. What we're looking for 5+ years of experience working in product, growth, or localisation roles within a high-growth Saa S or product-led company. Strong product and growth mindset, with an understanding of how India’s language ecosystem (including regional languages and English usage patterns) influences user behaviour and product adoption. Strong understanding of content and UX copy, including the ability to write and adapt English-language messaging for Indian users across product and growth surfaces. Experience working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders across product, marketing, content, and regional teams. Fluency in English, with strong proficiency in at least one major Indian language. Familiarity with multiple Indian languages is a strong plus. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and scaling solutions in complex, multi-market environments. A strategic thinker who is equally happy rolling up their sleeves and executing. Genuine passion for Canva’s mission to empower the world to design. About the Group/Team Canva’s International Supergroup is responsible for driving growth and deepening adoption across our key regions worldwide. We are an entrepreneurial, cross-functional team that turns bold strategy into culturally resonant execution. In India, our mission is to empower people across the country to design and express themselves, regardless of language, geography, or background. India represents one of Canva’s most important growth opportunities, with a deeply diverse language ecosystem, a rapidly expanding creator economy, and millions of users coming online for the first time. Our goal is to make Canva feel intuitive, accessible, and truly local for users across India. About the Role/Specialty As the India Localisation Lead, you will own Canva’s product and localisation experience in India, ensuring users across different regions and languages have the best possible Canva experience. You will be the voice of Indian users and a champion for culturally and linguistically relevant product experiences. This role goes beyond translation. It requires a strong understanding of India’s language landscape, how users switch between languages, and how localisation decisions impact trust, usability, and growth at scale.
